open_points.question: How does the sandbox learn that the per-file scratch limit was hit, and must the execution still be `resource_exhausted` when the agent code catches the write error?
options: The runner records every RLIMIT_FSIZE hit through a parent-visible channel, so the outcome is always `resource_exhausted`.
A caught write error is ordinary program behavior and the execution may succeed; only an uncaught error becomes `crashed`.
The signal is not ignored and its observation makes the outcome `resource_exhausted`.
open_points.default_guess: Have the runner record the limit hit independently of agent code and return `resource_exhausted` even when the code catches the write error.
